Word Sentences.main_question: Use any FIVE of the given words in your own sentences
Word Sentences.answer:
forgiveness: letting go of anger - The child asked for forgiveness after breaking a toy.
annoyance: a feeling of being irritated - There was annoyance when the bus was late.
urban: of a town or city - The urban area was full of tall buildings.
gratitude: being thankful - The class showed gratitude to the teacher.
ancient: very old - The ancient fort was built centuries ago.
sacrifice: giving something up for someone - Sharing lunch with a hungry friend was a sacrifice.

points.text: a correct sentence for five words

accept: any correct sentence that shows the meaning
scheme.common_error: a sentence that uses the word without showing its meaning

Rhyming Words.main_question: Read the poem and match each cue word with its rhyming word from the poem.
Rhyming Words.question: Morning Song
Rhyming Words.passage:
The sky is turning pale and white,
The stars have left the edge of night.
The grass along the path is wet,
The sun has not come up as yet.

scheme.common_error: pairing words that only look alike
